name: Eshmel
epithet: The Promised One / Herald of the Pale Raven
personality: Admires ambitious and highly talented people, and enjoys board games and small unnamed flowers.
story: The avatar: a soul placed in a Mediator body after the original was destroyed, awakened by the goddess Sothis and sent back in time to stop the demon god Balor from destroying the world by changing the fates of four heroes (Cai, Dietrich, Theodora, Leda).

personalSkill.name: Light of Salvation
personalSkill.effect: Neutralizes Underworld Boon on foes within 2 spaces. Lv20 adds Scorching Sun: 5% chance to reduce undead foe damage to 0.

joins: Automatically from the Prologue (Descent) and Chapter 1 (The White Bird). Base stats at Lv40 (Guardian): HP 50, Str 33, Mag 24, Dex 28, Spd 26, Lck 25, Def 23, Res 19, Cha 29.

build.role: Game-over anchor: spear hybrid and Underworld Boon breaker
build.notes: Light of Salvation strips Boon within 2; Vendetta (Leda's Part II copy) brakes his Celestial Wells gauge. The Trident is Theodora's.

guide.role: Game-over anchor: spear hybrid and the army's Underworld Boon breaker
guide.summary: Every Part III battle is lost if he falls, and every Boon foe within 2 of him loses its Boon. Walk him in the middle of the spear and axe users, fill his Celestial Wells gauge with the spear, and brake it with [[item:Vendetta]] at 10 to 11.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: one spear hit or a Blaze Art from Overblaze, ending within 2 of the units fighting Boon foes. Enemy phase: shield on, out of reach of anything that can two-shot him. Mission Time: station him in Dagsion so he can join any battle.
keys: Keep every spear and axe user within 2 of him: Light of Salvation strips their foes' Boon.
Finish Credna's request in Sec 3: The Nameless becomes the Shining Spear (Mt 18, Sol).
Gauge at 10-11: one combat with Vendetta (Curse 2) to drain it below Burst.
Arena Heavy weeks from Sec 2: Heavy C gives Armored Move+ (Mov +2).
Spear A by Lv 45 for Sentinel: Mounted Training to B, then fights.
watch: Game over: every Part III battle ends if he falls. Check bow and tome ranges every turn.
Weight: Bronze Spear +5 (Shining Spear from Sec 4) 7 + Silver Shield 4 = 11 over Bld ?. Vendetta (Wt 20) gets him doubled: poke at 3-5 only.
Gauge: Celestial Wells fills on his attacks; Burst at full (12?) drops Overblaze and halves max HP.
Undead: Vendetta can zero a hit (Offset Curse, not in the forecast). Never swing it at undead.
Ranks: join ranks ?. Sentinel needs Spear A at Lv 45; Arena seats bench first.

decisions.topic: Take Leda's Vendetta as the brake
decisions.pick: Vendetta from Leda's Part II clear; Leda's Muen stays stored
decisions.why: Vendetta hits at 1-2 and Supreme Serpent at 2-5 with no follow-up, so the brake combat is a safe poke. Muen is Hit 45 at range 1. Theodora keeps her own route's Muen and Vendetta.
decisions.else: Leda's Muen if that clear's Vendetta isn't in storage

decisions.why: His only Divine fit is The Trident (Spear S), and Theodora holds it (one holder). Sentinel keeps doubled White Magic, Magic Heal +10 and the spear.
